universities.name: University of Cambridge
universities.notes: UCAS deadline confirmed for 2027 entry. Tuition figures kept to single academic year 2025-26 to avoid mixing years; 2026-27 PDF also published. Email published in site footer/contact page; no admissions phone found on official page.

bullets: Check course-specific A-level/IB requirements before applying; offers usually based on 3 A-levels in Year 13; IB minimum typically 41-42 points with 776 in Higher Levels (some Colleges higher).
English language: IELTS Academic normally 7.5 overall (7.0+ each element) or equivalent C1 evidence; interview conducted in English (guideline 6.5 overall at application stage).
Course-dependent admission assessments, submitted work and interview form part of selection alongside UCAS application + My Cambridge Application.

costs.amount: USD 68574 tuition; USD 2655 fees (on-campus estimate, full-time, 9 months)

universities.name: California Institute of Technology - Caltech
universities.notes: Two decision plans (REA non-binding; RD majority of offers). Reply deadline 1 May 2027. Email address on contact page is Cloudflare-obfuscated, so email recorded as null.

bullets: Academic preparation: 4 years math including 1 year calculus; 1 year each of physics and chemistry (biology recommended); 4 years English; substitutions only via AP 5 / IB 6-7 / Schoolhouse.world certification with documented unresolvable conflict.
Standardized test: SAT or ACT required; reviewed via bucket ranges; report all sittings (superscored); AP/IB exams taken must be reported.

Application via Common App or QuestBridge: 2 teacher recommendations (1 STEM + 1 humanities/social sciences), school report, transcripts 9-11 + mid-year report; $85 fee or waiver; English proficiency exam for internationals unless exempt.

universities.name: ETH Zurich
universities.notes: Cycle year not stated on deadline page (annual window), so cycle_year=null. Phone is Bachelor Admissions Office line with limited hours (Mon-Fri excl Wed 9-11am); no admissions email published (contact form only). One programme application only.

bullets: Main teaching language is German; required German certificate must be met by 31 March application deadline or application rejected on formal grounds.
Country- and certificate-specific admission requirements published via swissuniversities; reduced/comprehensive entrance examination may be required depending on certificate.
Apply for one Bachelor programme only for Autumn Semester start via eApply with photo, ID, CV, school reports (last 3 years), leaving certificate, translations to German/English if needed.

universities.name: UCL - University College London
universities.notes: UCAS code UCL U80; no direct applications. International fees generally fixed at entry (cohort guarantee) except MBBS medicine (RPI-X). No admissions email on official page (contact form + phone only).

bullets: Must meet (or be predicted) minimum per-course requirements in online prospectus (e.g., Computer Science BSc A*A*A with A* in Maths/Further Maths); UCL does not use UCAS tariff points.
All applications via UCAS with academic reference; personal statement used for assessment; some courses require additional tests/portfolio/interview per course page.
English language and GCSE requirements as specified per course; UCL does not accept General Studies/Critical Thinking; UPC foundation route if qualification not accepted for direct entry.

universities.name: National University of Singapore - NUS
universities.notes: One application window per year; outcomes released progressively (generally by May-July depending on qualification). Cohort-based fees fixed for intake. No direct admissions email (FAQ portal + phone only). Programme URLs use official OAM hub + Computing + Law brochure to avoid inventing slugs.

bullets: Holistic admissions: academic merit + programme prerequisites + interests/aptitudes/preparation; must satisfy prerequisites of chosen programmes.
Interviews/tests required for Architecture, Dentistry, Industrial Design, Landscape Architecture, Law, Medicine, Music, Nursing, PPE.
One online application with S$10 fee (S$20 for international students with international qualifications); supporting documents + fee payment by closing date or submission incomplete.
